title: Surreal Selfie Mandala
description: A surreal scene featuring a dark-skinned figure in a checkered racing suit and ornate mask taking a selfie with a pink smartphone, framed in an ornate golden oval. Below, a marble table holds an open book with black birds, a knight in armor, a lit red candle with dripping wax, colorful flowers, and fruit, while a giant praying mantis perches above the frame against a swirling green sky.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal painting shows a masked figure in a black and white checkered racing suit and silver gloves taking a selfie with a pink phone inside an ornate golden oval frame. A giant green praying mantis sits atop the frame. In the foreground, a marble table displays an open book with flying black birds, a medieval knight in armor wearing a face mask, a melting red candle, vibrant pink and orange flowers, grapes, and a glowing orange spiral mandala. A smaller floating pink oval reveals a gothic cathedral. The background features swirling green patterns and a blue sky.
